formulas.precision: TP/(TP+FP); zero candidate denominator is N/A
formulas.recall: TP/(TP+FN); zero gold denominator is N/A
formulas.duplicates: every candidate after the first matched identity is FP
formulas.validated: validated candidates are an unchanged subset of raw candidates
formulas.unique_sources: same source across role views counts once
formulas.coverage_micro: sum passed targets / sum eligible targets
formulas.coverage_macro: unweighted mean of per-source coverage rates

coverage_groups: caller-frozen family/channel/risk tags; each reports micro and per-source macro rates
